chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Faḍālah, from Ḥammād, from Ismāʿīl ibn Jābir, who said:
I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, “Should I perform the witr after dawn has risen?” He said, “No.”

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ: A kunyah referring to Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: Can witr be performed after fajr has risen according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling about the final time for performing the witr prayer in relation to the rise of dawn. Imam Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام answers in the negative, indicating that witr is not to be performed after fajr has risen.
